title: Agent settings document
description: config/settings.json (PLAN.md S06, S08): agent name, ports, remote UI, zeroconf, logging and retention. Defaults: uiPort 8480, linkPort 8481, remoteUi false (D-018, O-03), zeroconf true (T216), trayIcon true (T310).

prometheus.description: The optional Prometheus endpoint GET /metrics on the HTTPS listener (T709). Off by default; needs the read-only token of POST /api/v1/prometheus/token; exposes only the listed numeric and boolean metrics.

hardwareSensors.description: The optional hardware sensors (T707, ADR 0002): temperatures, fan speeds and power draw of the processor, graphics cards, mainboard and drives, read through LibreHardwareMonitorLib. They need the kernel driver PawnIO, which the user installs separately. Off by default; while off, neither the library nor a driver handle is loaded.

updates.description: The check for a newer release (T704, D-046): once per interval the agent asks the GitHub releases API of the project for the newest release and reports it as the metrics agent.latest_version, agent.release_url and agent.release_notes. It is the only request the agent makes to the internet on its own. On by default; with check false the agent makes no such request. intervalHours defaults to 24.

hotkeys.description: Global hotkeys (T708). The SessionHost of the user's session registers each enabled key combination; pressing it raises the event hotkey_pressed with the data name. Names are unique; the validator also checks that keys parse (modifiers Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win and one key) and that no combination is used twice among the enabled hotkeys.

reverseLink.description: The optional reverse link to Home Assistant for roaming devices (T710, ADR 0003): the agent dials the WebSocket endpoint of the integration. Off by default. The credential is not part of the document (secret store, reverse_link.token). A ws:// URL is only valid for a loopback host, which the validator checks.
